typed_triad.irreducibility: The frozen three-role representation has rank 3; deletion of any role reduces rank to 2. A scalar rank-1 collapse is rejected.

recursive_kernel.law: K_f(tau)=Sum_j delta^(-j) f_j exp(-alpha j tau)
recursive_kernel.tau_semantics: prephysical ordering argument only; not physical time

relational_completion.witness_rule: No route, branch, event, or closure is admitted without a locally generated witness certificate.
relational_completion.gauge_rule: Gauge-equivalent route representatives do not create additional independent closures.
relational_completion.new_solution_rule: A new solution requires a distinct non-gauge witnessed closure; lane count alone is insufficient.
relational_completion.no_loss_rule: Only redundant representatives may be quotient-removed; witnessed closure and return-memory ancestry are retained.
relational_completion.reopening_rule: Stored return-memory may lawfully reopen a prior relational configuration without erasing ancestry.
relational_completion.branch_event_rule: Branch and event objects inherit exact witnessed route/gauge ancestry.

manifestation_theorem_scope.statement: The relational carrier admits arbitrarily large finite-N directed-lane structure. An unbounded family of distinct manifested solutions follows only under the additional condition that arbitrarily many N admit distinct non-gauge witnessed closures.
manifestation_theorem_scope.prohibited_inference: Unbounded solution multiplicity may not be inferred from lane-count growth alone.

strongest_supported_claim: Module A verifies the typed prephysical RFC constitution, First Action, recursive kernel, and witnessed relational completion at mathematical/prephysical scope.
strongest_unsupported_claim: Module A does not establish a physical universe, physical time, geometry, particles, fields, or a physically executed Big Implosion.
claim_boundary: Mathematical constitution and relational enhancement only; no physical universe yet.
